unlisted_practices: Treat patient consent for AI and digital health data use as continuous, situated, and structurally aware rather than a one-time checkbox event.
Calibrate privacy and security safeguards to the sensitivity zone of the data, with stricter protections for intimate biometric and genetic data than for public metadata.
Design telemedicine platforms with transparency, auditability, and minimal data collection as core structural safeguards.
Use end-to-end encryption, granular privacy settings, and strict access controls in telemedicine platforms.
Prioritize international cooperation in privacy regulation for digital health and AI data flows.
Require explicit opt-in before repurposing patient data for commercial uses such as targeted advertising.
